We offer over 100,000 quality parts from industry-leading manufacturers like 3M, Deutsch, Hellerman Tyton, and Pollak with 12,000+ products available for same-day shipping. Our inventory management system anticipates your company’s needs and helps ensure you never run out of critical parts. And when you do need to restock, our knowledgeable and friendly customer service staff is there to help!

Every project is completed with expert craftsmanship, attention to detail, and a commitment to quality, ensuring long-lasting results you can rely on. Whether you're upgrading your off-road vehicle, building a one-of-a-kind trailer, or need custom metal fabrication, Steel Nutz Metal Fabrication is dedicated to bringing your vision to life with precision, durability, and exceptional service.
